description: Full detail for one property by its Booli residence id — the number in a booli.se/bostad/<id> URL, or the `residence_id` from a search result. Works for both active and sold properties. Read-only.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact returns the slim PropertySummary/detail projection; "full" returns Booli's whole GraphQL node.

name: booli_get_listing
title: Get a Booli property
